steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Hoo...

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Why... What is wrong with this body of mine?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Leave it to me!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Madam Catapult?!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Don't get distracted!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: You don't have to tell me!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Madam Orchid, you—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Heh, made it in the nick of time!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What's the matter, Hofukaru?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I... do not know, but I can sense a force most sinister pulling at my body.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Don't worry, I'll finish things up here!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: So this guy's the real Iju? Just gotta take care of it and we can go home, yeah?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Orchid, cover me!
Super Amped Element Discharge. Catapult has been in love with this move from the moment she heard its name. It was just so awe-inspiring.

Of course, she loves performing it even more. Slamming the axe into the ground and using the force of its recoil—and an assist from a Wirebug—to leap high into the sky before giving the axe another big swing!
First, make sure Element Phials are full. Yep, they're full. Her shield glows red, as if urging her on.
Observe the target. The Escorchgot is showing an opening in its defense, A perfect opportunity.

Then, jump. Gain an initial burst of kinetic energy by hitting the ground with your charge blade, and at the same time, pull yourself into the air with a Wirebug. Hah, whoever invented this move was a genius!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: So, is it gonna get back up again?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Rest easy. The Iju is truly dead now.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Hofukaru, you...

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I am fine. The force I sensed tugging on me hath disappeared.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What was it, exactly?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I... do not know.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: But thou mayest rest easy all the same. We have completed the Iju hunt. Next, I shall send thee home, as is tradition.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Congratulations, Your Majesty.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Let us dispense with the pleasantries, Midnight.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I am simply expressing my heartfelt joy over your victory alongside the Iju Hunters.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Seeing as thou art so happy for me, allow me to seek the Lord of Thunder.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: That is a separate matter entirely.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Enough. Listening to you go at it again is giving me a headache. So, we took out the current Iju. Now what?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Next, Her Majesty will purify the Iju's corpse, then restart the Gyorin to send you two home.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: What of the Rite of Return?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Your Majesty.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: 'Tis tradition.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: What's this about a rite?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: The Rite of Return is meant to express our gratitude to the Gyorin for its gift, as well as to let us bid farewell to our brave Iju Hunters.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: We shall bring this corpse back to Houei City, where I shall purify it via ceremony.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Once that is done, the citizens shall extract the most useful materials, and use them to create weapons and tools that we offer to the Iju Hunters as commemoration.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: The rest is turned into foodstuffs, or perhaps trinkets for the Rite.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: And at the very end of the Rite, I shall restart the Gyorin and send the Iju Hunters home.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Dost thou wish the Iju Hunters to think our nation ungrateful, Midnight?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: ...In the past, the people may have rejoiced at hearing the Iju had been hunted.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: But this time, the Lord of Thunder yet lives. This is no time for celebration.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Even so—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Stop.

steps.name: Midnight & Hofukaru
steps.text: What is it, Madam Orchid?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: It's urgent that we get home as soon as possible. I wouldn't be in the mood for a festival anyway.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: We're also well aware of your people's hospitality by now.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Besides, Midnight is right. Houei is still in the middle of a national emergency.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I appreciate your understanding, Madam Orchid.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: But are you really alright with this, Hofukaru?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: ...I am.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: What was Orchid asking Her Meowjesty just now?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: She was asking if Hofukaru's really okay with us hunting only the Escorchgot.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: And she said yes.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: But didn't Orchid want to go home the meowst? It almost sounded like she would have helped hunt the Zinogre if Her Meowjesty had insisted.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Why take on even more trouble?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: That's just the kind of person she is.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: She might act like she doesn't care about other people's problems, and that she's only doing her own thing, but in the end, she always lets herself get dragged in.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Followed up by her legendary 'Well, what else can I do?'

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: What a purr-fect contradiction.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Well, as mew can see, she is one.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Don't copy my accent!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Talking about me behind my back again?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I'd never! We were just talking about how you're the best team leader a girl could ask for.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Oh really now?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Madam Orchid, Madam Catapult, given the urgency, I shall perform the ceremony here and now.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Pray step back a little.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What's she going to do?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: She's gonna dance.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Watch closely. This might be our last chance to see it.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Dance?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Indeed.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: This body as a cage—
As Hofukaru dances, the remaining black miasma clinging to the corpse of the Escorchgot begins to be drawn away, slowly and methodically being absorbed into her.
Even as her face grows pale, her gaze remains steeled.
As the black miasma passes through her body, it seems to be 'filtered' by some sort of power, ultimately turning into a pure, colorless energy that flows into the Gyorin behind her.
The arch of the Gyorin begins to glow a soft white. This light intensifies, until a silver-white 'door' appears beside Hofukaru.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: It worked! Look, Orchid! We can go home now!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Wait! Something doesn't feel right!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Huh—

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: This fate as a guide—
The moment the Gyorin's light reaches the peak of its brilliance, it suddenly dies out without warning. All sound and color seem to have been wiped from the world, leaving only a deathly silence.
The white of the 'door' turns black in an instant, before something darker than black begins to bubble out of it.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: That thing... looks like a tuskbeast, but also nothing like one. What the heck is going on?!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Hexhowls... Why would Hexhowls appear here?!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: A last-second plot twist?!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What's this all about, Midnight?!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: The Hexhowls are something that should not exist...

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Long ago, there was a great disaster in this realm. In the midst of that disaster, a pack of cursed wolves destroyed the old kingdom of Houei.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Those wolves were the Hexhowls.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: The survivors, our ancestors, rebuilt Houei before hunting those wolves to near-extinction.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: 'Wolves'... You mean tuskbeasts?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Well, whatever they are, they just keep popping out! Can't you do something about it, Hofukaru?!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I cannot!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Something is stopping me from closing the Gyorin!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: The Hexhowls... Their very existence portends disaster. Did I summon them, perchance—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Stay calm! This is not your fault!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: She is right, Your Majesty! The ceremony was flawless! There must be some other—
Everyone turns their heads in alarm. Above, on a faraway cliff, a titanic beast covered in cyan scales and teal lightning raises its head to howl heavenward.
It stands high atop the precipice, pointing its snout disdainfully down at the chaos.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: The Lord of Thunder?!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Is it affecting the Gyorin?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Lord of Thunder, wert thou... awaiting this moment?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Thou didst not interfere in my hunt, for thou wert waiting for me to start the Gyorin?!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Answer me!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: ANSWER ME—!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: You must not act rashly, Your Majesty!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: The Lord of Thunder hath trampled upon the trial!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Dost thou mean to stop me even now, Midnight?!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I—
Suddenly, the loud clanging of a bell echoes from the foot of the mountain.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What's that sound?!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: It's the alarm!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: The Association's emergency alarm... It would never be sounded unless—

steps.name: Samurai
steps.text: Grave news, Shogun!

steps.name: Samurai
steps.text: Great hordes of cursed beasts have emerged from both the bamboo forest and the mountain! They're coming from the direction of the Gyorin!

steps.name: Samurai
steps.text: They're already near the capital!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Relay my orders! Have the Association organize a defensive line! Do not allow those beasts to approach the city, no matter what!

steps.name: Samurai
steps.text: What will you be doing, Shogun? We require your command!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I... I will return to the capital posthaste.

steps.name: Samurai
steps.text: Yes, sir!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: So that thing's not just stopping us from going home, it's also summoning beasts from the gate. But why?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Who cares? We just need to take out their leader to send them all packing!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: The Lord of Thunder's in charge, right? If we want to settle things, we'll need to cut a path to it, Hofukaru!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hofukaru?
Catapult walks up to Hofukaru and pulls on her arm, but the girl does not move an inch.
Only now does she see the expression on her face—
A gnashing of teeth, both in rage and frustration.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Cut the crap, Catapult.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: How do you know Houei won't be destroyed by the Hexhowls before you even reach it?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: But there's no end to these black beasts! They'll just keep pouring from the gates!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: A decapitation strike is our best option! And if we keep dawdling, who knows where it'll run off to?!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Don't forget, Hofukaru's the only one who can purify the curse.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: ...Arrgghhhh! Why does everything have to be such a pain?! That thundering bastard!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: At the very least, we can't put Houei in jeopardy before we're sure of what we're doing.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: The Lord of Thunder's right there! If we miss this chance, we might never get another one!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I forbade Her Majesty from hunting it before because, ultimately, it had yet to bare its fangs at us.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: However, now that it is the source of this calamity, if Her Majesty wishes to eliminate it, I shall not bar her way.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Still...

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Say no more.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Madam Orchid is right.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I am the lord of this nation. Even were I to carve a bloody path to it right now, what meaning would that have if Houei were to fall first?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: We return to the city. Prepare to repel the horde.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: As you command.
Hofukaru turns toward the capital.
But before she does, she takes one long look at the Lord of Thunder, atop the distant peak.
As if she is engraving its likeness onto her very soul.
